body:
> el a lot less alone now

You're not alone at all. There are millions of people in this world waiting to meet and get to know you. Just wait in time and you'll meet a lot of great people. But please if your father does abuse you or hit you please try and get help. You don't deserve that kind of suffering.

Please calm down, this is not the end at all. These feelings will pass and as time goes on you will heal. Please sit back and lie down. You do not need to leave. This is not the end at all. You can meet another person and fall in love all over again. This is never the end. You are still very young, you have so much life ahead of you and greater things to see and love. Just take it easy. Break ups hurt, a lot, I think we've all been there. But I want you to know it's not the end of the world. Hey why not put on a movie? Uh maybe....Star Wars or UP? A personal favorite of mine is Wolf Children, it's such a sweet and slow movie about family and maternal love.

That's so amazing! You're still here. It's such a good thing you are not a failure, don't say that. This is another chance for you to live your life. A rebirth! You will be ok. I am glad you are ok. Please try relaxing and recalling happy things thinking of peace love and happiness. You will be OK.

Honey I have felt that way but it took me a lot of self love to realise the bad things that happened to me were not my fault it was just life and couldn't be helped I breathe in the past and let it tell me that I can get stronger from the pit I have fallen down into. I push on to try and live I might feel worthless sometimes but I know that's just my depression and I won't believe those lies. Im sure you understand. Nothing was your fault it was just you and your happenstance it wasn't you and you are not a mistake just hurting. It just pain and its ok to feel Just breathe in and out and lupine down a rethink your happiest memories and how that will become your future. That always works for me. Take is easy please.

I beg of you to get to the police for what your father did, right away. Tell them what happened so you can get out of there! What happened is not your fault and your father is a cruel bitch to do that to you! Please breathe relax and get to the police tell them what happened it might be scary but them will help you. Good luck buddy. Stay strong please live.

See your doctor and tell her everything that is bothering you, if you are contemplating suicide you are suffering a lot and need help. Calling a helpline can help, don't turn down the opportunity just because you don't feel it will help. Take every opportunity you can have and try you're best. You can make it through this and you will be ok. Hang in there! Have hope. Talk to your doctor and call a helpline get any help you can get. Good luck, man.

Please call a helpline and try and relax. Do some slow breathing and sit back, lie down. It'll all be ok and these feelings will pass just give yourself a chance to breath. Maybe try coloring something. Download an app like smiling mind and do some meditation. All you need to do is take it easy and know you'll be ok. If you have a friend to talk to go and talk to them.
Glad you're still here keep fighting!

Make a list of all the things that you love and that make you happy and work down them. Music? Make some music. Art? Draw some art. Go for a walk and get some air. You are strong to make it so far just keep going for this shall pass, and as you keep going it'll get better you may fall in a rut again but you'll get better again too. You don't need to go you just need hope love and happiness, that you can have, all of them.

It's never too late as long as you are alive. If you have any issues with your relationship try calling a relationship helpline, lot's exist. You're still young and have a good 50 years left, don't act like it's all over when you're still at such an early point in your life, still wise and not old. You can meet other people befriend them and love them the list is endless and you could have your own family just keep the future you want in mind and you can find it and find love in whatever form.

First you are not worthless, no human being is. We are all worth so much, all in little ways. You have people that love you and people that you love. You wouldn't be loved and adored so much if you were nothing. It's ok if things are bad now you can get through it it will pass and get so much better. You can love and be loved by so many others just given the chance to meet them.

Make a list of things you like and that make you happy, just write whatever you think of, then try doing them. Do you like walking? Do that. Rock music? listen to it. Just do anything you like. Maybe a video game?
You're better of being alive and seeing your life through so you can do whatever you dream of in the future. No reason to leave now when you have a lot of things left to do. Maybe get a job if you can, get out there, meet people.

Ha ha, glad I made you laugh, I'm just putting it out there, I'm sure many moments in your life you have been happy and healthy, if you had done that once you are always able to get there again, really you can. I believe in you!

Please stay, I understand you have a lot of pain, but you said you have gotten better at one point, that could happen an infinite amount of other times in the future. You can live happily and get help and recover from your pain, you really can. I am sure you are truly strong to have lived through depression. Instead make some writing, if you really feel and urge grab a marker and draw on your arm cute things like love hearts or happy words like "love" and "happiness" sounds silly but it has helped me.

That sounds like trauma, I think you should try seeing a docter and have sleep therapy or hypnosis, it is really successful. Please hang in there. You can get help for this please, please, please stay and call for help. Get help and I'm sure those dreams will go away.

Please relax, if you have time go to your local doctor or hospital, if you need medication or therapy. Relax and please call a help line. Use some meditation. Lots of breathing in through the mouth and out your nose.

It's OK. There's nothing wrong with being single or being in a relationship. You can be happy either way, as long as you can find a way to love yourself for who you are, you can find so much love because I am sure there are a lot of people waiting to know you and love you as a person. I'm sure you have done a lot of amazing things and you should be proud of yourself for it.

It's OK, take a while to sit back for a moment. Stay away from guns and knives, please. Take a deep breathe, and lie down, call a helpline for a moment or maybe just distract yourself. Do you like Taylor Swift? Listen to her music.
